Cross-filing checks: FY2023 equal in the FY2023 and FY2024 filings (revenue 11,033,429; NI 3,864,110; CFO 5,679,990) so no restatement; 9M2024/H1 2024/Q1 2024 comparatives in the 2025 filings equal the 2024 filings; 6M2025 revenue 6,361,394 + Q3 3,521,527 = 9M 9,882,921; Q2 2025 = H1 - Q1 (3,287,449 = 6,361,394 - 3,073,945). The 9M2023 filing shows 2022 comparatives marked reclassified (Note 17) - they are comparatives, not 2023 values. Interim income statements carry both quarter and cumulative columns; cash flows are cumulative only (discrete quarters must be derived by subtraction).
